title: Numbers
add_note: You bring your own number — the contract stays with your provider. Pointing it at the agent, and the SIP credentials that needs, come with the phone milestone.
empty_body: Add the number you bought from your provider and it appears here. The contract stays yours — Tel-Agent only keeps the record.
error_invalid_e164: A number is written as +, country code, digits — like +43 720 123456.
error_number_taken: This workspace already has that number.
error_platform_number: This number is held by the platform and cannot be released here.
error_offline_title: The server could not be reached
